title: Fix Deploy workflow failure by resolving CI-blocking ESLint errors
body:
The `build-and-deploy` Actions job failed during `react-scripts build` because CI treats ESLint warnings as errors. This PR removes the reported lint violations in React components so the deployment workflow can proceed past the build step.

- **ESLint cleanup (unused symbols)**
  - Removed unused imports in:
    - `src/App.js`
    - `src/Components/About/About.jsx`
    - `src/Components/Projects/Projects.jsx`
    - `src/Components/Skill/Skill.jsx`

- **External link hardening for `_blank` targets**
  - Added `rel="noreferrer"` to external anchors using `target="_blank"` in:
    - `src/Components/Home/Home.jsx`
    - `src/Components/Projects/Projects.jsx`

- **Representative change**
  ```jsx
  // before
  <a href={liveLink} target="_blank">

  // after
  <a href={liveLink} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
  ```
